:::{#exm-convex-set}
#### Convex sets

- $\reals^p$ is convex, and so is any set with at most one point.
- The [closed ball](vector-calculus.qmd#def-closed-ball) $B = \cb{\vx : \norm{\vx} \le r}$ is convex:
  for $\vx, \vy \in B$ and $t \in [0, 1]$,

  $$
  \ba
  \norm{t \vx + (1 - t) \vy}
  &\le \norm{t \vx} + \norm{(1 - t) \vy}
  && \text{(triangle inequality)}
  \\
  &= t\,\norm{\vx} + (1 - t)\,\norm{\vy}
  && \text{(norm of a multiple; } t, 1 - t \ge 0 \text{)}
  \\
  &\le t\,r + (1 - t)\,r
  && \text{(} \vx, \vy \in B \text{)}
  \\
  &= r.
  && \text{(arithmetic)}
  \ea
  $$

  The first step is the [triangle inequality](linear-algebra.qmd#thm-triangle-inequality),
  and the second uses [the norm of a multiple](linear-algebra.qmd#thm-norm-properties).

:::
